title: Best AI App Builder for Solo Founders & Bootstrappers in 2026
summary: We scored eight AI app builders on the eight things that actually matter to a one-person, self-funded founder: long-term affordability, reliability without a team, and whether the tool helps you get users, not just build.
body_markdown: No, and this is the gap most comparison articles miss. A 2026 analysis of 600 recent indie-hacker forum posts found "getting users to convert" scored highest on a Pain Signal Score of real founder complaints, ahead of validating the idea, deciding what to focus on, and finding leads. Writing the code was rarely the struggle described. That's why built-in distribution tooling is one of our eight scored criteria here, and why Blink's Blink Claw growth agents are a genuine differentiator, not a nice-to-have.
